findings.passage: “The freedom to vote,” Shaw said. “That is what we are fighting for. Not only for Texans but across America there has been a slew of legislation filed — at least 46 states — to restrict voter access and to have chilling effects on voters.”
findings.note: Quoted in an interview write-up on a political web show (published 2021-07-20) about why she left Texas with other House members to deny a quorum on the 2021 election bills (HB 3 and SB 1). The quote is general, not about ID or citizenship rules specifically.
